title_en: Good News (16/20): A Twelve-Year-Old Chess Grandmaster
note_en: 只有…才… means "only if…, then (and not otherwise)": 只有 names the one necessary condition and 才 goes before the verb of the result. 只有每天坚持练习…，才能在这么小的年纪达到这么高的水平 "Only by practicing every day… can you reach such a high level at such a young age." Compare 只要…就…, "as long as…": that marks a condition that is enough, while 只有…才… marks one you can't do without.
